🏡 Little House in the Big Woods

The Ingalls family's little gray log house in the Big Woods of Wisconsin, c. 1871 — from Laura Ingalls Wilder's book. The cabin, attic and cellar, garden, barn, smokehouse, wheat-field clearing and the woods themselves. Every building is hollow — go inside, climb to the attic, duck down to the cellar.

Walk: click Start, mouse to look, W A S D to move, Shift hurry, Space jump.

Follow the numbered stops ①–⑮ — their cards appear as you arrive. The smaller gold markers, numbered 16–35, are points of interest: get close, then aim the crosshair dot at the number and click (or press E) to read its fact. O = bird's-eye view.
